about.title: About All Seasons Painting
text: Founded in 2015 by Andres, All Seasons Painting LLC brings decades of combined experience, premium materials, and personal service to every home and business we touch.

My dad Leonardo started this company in 2015 in League City. He came up doing it the hard way — mixing his own colors, doing prep himself, building a reputation one house at a time. My brother and I grew up in it. By the time I was helping on weekends, I already knew how to cut a straight line around trim and why you never skip the primer.

Today the whole family is involved. My mom Judith handles the office side. My brother Leonardo Jr. and I are out on jobs most days. We've painted well over 500 homes in League City, Clear Lake, Friendswood, Pearland, and the surrounding area. That number doesn't count the commercial jobs — parking lots, offices, storefronts, apartment complexes.
